name: ucie-engineering
description: Local utilities for UCIe architecture review, RTL/SVA scaffolding, UVM planning, traceability audits, and generic CRC reference calculations.
long_description: A local STDIO MCP server for source-grounded UCIe engineering workflows. Deterministic helpers only; no filesystem access, shell execution, simulator execution, or compliance certification.

tools.name: ucie_validate_project_manifest
tools.description: Validate required structure and source/scope fields in a UCIe project manifest.

tools.name: ucie_review_architecture_inputs
tools.description: Find missing architecture review inputs; not a normative compliance checker.

tools.name: ucie_generate_sv_module_shell
tools.description: Generate a declaration-only SystemVerilog module shell from a supplied port list.

tools.name: ucie_generate_sva_skeleton
tools.description: Generate an SVA skeleton using overlapped or non-overlapped implication.

tools.name: ucie_generate_ready_valid_sva
tools.description: Generate generic ready/valid hold assertions using next-cycle semantics; not a UCIe interface definition.

tools.name: ucie_generate_uvm_agent_skeleton
tools.description: Generate UVM transaction, sequence, sequencer, driver, monitor, and agent class shells from an explicit interface type and field list.

tools.name: ucie_generate_uvm_testplan
tools.description: Draft a verification plan from explicit feature and requirement records.

tools.name: ucie_crc16_ccitt_false
tools.description: Calculate generic CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE; not a UCIe-specific CRC implementation.
